scene: A phone vlog on a windy hill path above a small city, on the second day of a football weekend. Wind. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and talks to it; Timo lies face down on the path just behind her.
context: A twenty-second comedy sketch played by two close friends who bicker. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and a little out of breath; to her everything is good news and she is innocent, never sarcastic. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry, proud and exhausted; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast, with no gaps between the lines.
lines: [bright, calling over the wind, out of breath] Day two of the football trip!
[muffled and flat, face down in the grass] Why is there a mountain in the football trip?
[to the camera, a little less sure] The planner had a switch. It said: hikes.
[quick, defensive] I like the idea of hikes.
[slow, patient] So why did you flip it?
[amazed that he has to ask, as if this explains everything] It was a switch!
[after a beat, low and suspicious] What else did you flip?
[quietly, reading it off her phone] Tomorrow morning. Run.
[from the ground, muffled, a tired plea] Flip it back.
[sunny again, to the camera] He loves it.
[a long, low, tired groan from the ground] Uuuugh.
